title: STARTEX: Level 3 Declared, CMT Bridge Opens

fields.location: Ironcrest Machinery Corporation (fictional): Headquarters, Rockford, Illinois; Plants 1–3 in Rockford, Beloit and Dubuque; Parts Distribution Center, Joliet
fields.weather: Rockford overcast, 44°F, light wind. No weather issues at any site.
fields.load: Quarter-end push, six days before quarter end. Joliet was on track for its usual 4,100 parts orders.
fields.staffing: Normal three-shift production at Plants 1, 2 and 3. Crisis Management Team members are joining the bridge now.
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 15:00 Central Time on Thursday, March 25, 2027, six days before quarter end. All three plants were on normal three-shift production for the quarter-end push. At 13:40 Plant 3 Dubuque reported a hung MES. At 14:05 the SOC found ransomware encrypting the file servers and the MES at the Rockford data center. At 14:25 CISO Anil Deshmukh isolated the network, and at 14:50 CEO Thomas Aldridge declared Level 3. The Crisis Management Team is now joining the bridge at (815) 555-0121. This is an exercise aid, not legal advice. Check the current rule and your counsel.

status.name: Manufacturing execution system (MES), Rockford data center
status.note: Ransomware encrypting since at least 14:05 CT. RTO is 8 hours.

status.name: File servers, Rockford data center
status.note: Encryption found by the SOC at 14:05 CT.

status.name: Corporate network
status.note: Isolated at 14:25 CT by the CISO. Status of connected systems not yet confirmed.

status.name: Plant 3 Dubuque MES
status.note: Reported hung at 13:40 CT. Cause not yet confirmed.

status.name: Life-safety, fire and gas systems, all sites
status.note: Normal. These run on separate networks.

status.name: Crisis governance
status.note: Level 3 declared at 14:50 CT by the CEO. CMT must meet within 60 minutes of the declaration.

fields.facilitatorNote: Before you read, check that every role has the ICMP and IBIARO extracts and a blank one-page decision log. Do not give out MES backup age, replica status, ransom demand or which other systems are affected. Those come in later injects.
fields.scenarioTitle: Six Days Out: MES Ransomware, Materiality & Disclosure

instructorNote: This card sets the baseline and starts the clock. Watch for three things: the CEO confirms the 14:50 Level 3 declaration and that the CMT met within 60 minutes; the BCM opens the decision log with time, decision, who decided, what was known and the basis (ICMP 3); and the team accepts 14:05 as the discovery time, which means the materiality clock is already running.
